featured_reviews.review_text:
My Google Review # 000294.

This is a good, spacious and a grand club situated in the key location of Juhu!

Not sure whether it is pricy to that extent compared to the fashionable  Juhu culture, but, it is well maintained. The banquet halls where I attended a couple of functions are huge enough to accommodate 1000+ guests easily.

They have an open to sky terrace restaurant also, to give you a natural environment for your buffet dining needs. The staff was well behave and the lights and air conditioning was also good.

The toilets are congested and could have been kept cleaner, considering the “club” tag that this place boasts off.

The buffet lunch served was very-very decent. The LIVE roti counter and the multiple dessert options were my favourite ones. The service was good and the staff ensured that guests’ needs were taken care of.

The premise is located on an approach road itself and has decent parking space inside and on the approach road. There was no VALET arrangement when I had visited. Credit and debit cards are accepted. And, you may even pay in CASH and transact in UPI.

Definitely, it is worth another visit as there is much more to this property that I could not explore.

Date of Experience: January 2022.

featured_reviews.name: shailesh solanki
featured_reviews.review_text:
My engagement function was organized in Mithila Banquets and we family regret it now. We had to get the function done as it was hardly a week left. In the first meeting, the staff was so co-operative and behaved really good with us but the real truth we experienced before few days of our function and on the day of our function.
-HIDDEN CHARGES: Before a week of the function when we discussed the menu rates etc, the staff member quietly included a hidden charge of covering the open space with roof and did not even bother to discuss with us. She tried her best to hide the expense but mentioned in the paper. Just because it rained before 10 days and then no rain since then, they covered the open space and were charging customer Rs. 7000. We mentioned that we do not need the roof as initially in our meetings we discussed open and so we selected in first place. When we saw the expense and enquired the staff member Varsha fought with us on top of her voice.
-FOOD: Most of our family members, friends and guests were infected with stomach infection and diarrhea the night of the function and the next day.
-SERVICE:
a. The Sofa set they kept were unclean and had all Pen marks over it and looked dirty. Before the guests arrived we asked them to replace and they said Yes, but they did not replace and our family had to sit on the sofa which were bad in condition
b. Toilets: Entering the toilet, it was water and urination all over the place. No proper place to wash the place. The toilets were not cleaned and the flushes did not work. The toilets and the outside area smelled so bad. All the workers visited the same toilets and did not bother to clean the toilets.
c. CHARGES: For Rs. 1200 per plate, the food, service & behavior of the staff is NOT WORTH AT ALL. You will find other good places with low rate and good facilities of cleaner toilets, sofas and chairs and food too.
d. FOUL PLAY: IMPORTANT: Before the function they informed the police will arrive and we will have to pay them 7 thousand. And during our function not even an hour of starting the function, the police arrived and took money from them which they asked us to pay after the function. The staff itself calls the Police and takes money from us. We family/friends/guests no one saw the police. The banquet is on 2nd floor with no lifts, the music played will never reach the ground level.

NEVER EVER visit this place as it is NOT WORTH for the Food, Service and Foul Play they carry out just before few days of function. There are many other good options other than Mithila Banquets. This experience is a bad one and no one should go through what we went through.
